HARUKA_RELIC_PROTECT_BUBBLE.title: Fleeting Bubble
HARUKA_RELIC_PROTECT_BUBBLE.description: At the start of combat, [gold]Channel[/gold] 1 [gold]Bubble[gold] Orb.
HARUKA_RELIC_PROTECT_PLUS_BUBBLE.title: Shimmering Foam
HARUKA_RELIC_PROTECT_PLUS_BUBBLE.descrip:
At the start of combat, [gold]Channel[/gold] 1 [gold]Bubble[gold] Orb.
After a [gold]Bubble is Evoked[/gold], heal 2 HP. (Up to 4 times per combat.)
HARUKA_RELIC_CARROT_PIE.title: Carrot Pie
HARUKA_RELIC_CARROT_PIE.description: At the end of your turn, gain 1 [gold]Vigor[/gold] for each card in your hand.
HARUKA_RELIC_PICKAXE.title: Pickaxe
HARUKA_RELIC_PICKAXE.description: The first time you deal more than [blue]15[/blue] [gold]attack damage[/gold] each turn, draw 1 card.
HARUKA_RELIC_BACK_PACK.title: Desert Backpack
HARUKA_RELIC_BACK_PACK.description: At the start of each combat, add 1 random card from your draw pile that can grant [gold]Block[/gold] to your hand. It costs 0 this turn.
